name: Office worker normal activity profile v1
description: Normal office worker activity in this project means reading or creating safe local documents, adding notes, organizing simple files, and using office-document stubs. Shell commands are generally abnormal for this role.

expected_sequences.description: Inspect source material, create a document stub, then append details.
List files, inspect one, then create an organized note.

role_notes: Office worker profile prioritizes documentation workflows.
normality_notes: High shell-command usage is considered abnormal for this role.
